mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a robust demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and inflation rate signals a monetary policy environment that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rate and inflation rate (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers an increase in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of low unemployment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and retail sales signals a robust demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of strong GDP growth and retail sales during monetary easing are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
